blocks.text: Company: Forward Move, LLC d/b/a My Guardian Link™
Mailing Address: 2680 Vernon Road, Green Bay, WI 54304

This Child / Guardian Consent Policy (“Policy”) explains how Forward Move, LLC d/b/a My Guardian Link™ (“My Guardian Link,” “Company,” “we,” “us,” or “our”) handles accounts, profiles, personal information, location information, trusted contacts, urgent alerts, emergency profile information, and service use involving children, minors, parents, legal guardians, caregivers, family members, sponsor groups, school-related groups, organization groups, and other authorized adult representatives.

This Policy supplements and is incorporated into the My Guardian Link Terms of Use, Privacy Policy, Acceptable Use Policy, SMS/Calling Terms, Subscription/Refund/Auto-Renewal Terms, Master Services Agreement, Data Processing Addendum, Sponsor Group Addendum, Referral Group Addendum, and any other applicable agreement.
By creating, managing, authorizing, paying for, supervising, or allowing a child or minor to use My Guardian Link, you agree to this Policy.

My Guardian Link is not a police department, fire department, ambulance service, public safety answering point, government emergency service, emergency medical provider, security company, or law enforcement agency.

My Guardian Link supports urgent communication, trusted contact notification, location sharing, response coordination, and possible escalation to a third-party urgent response contact center, central station, public safety resource, roadside provider, caregiver, parent, guardian, or other appropriate resource when available and appropriate.
If a child, minor, parent, guardian, caregiver, or trusted contact can safely call 911 or local emergency services directly, they should do so.

My Guardian Link does not guarantee alert delivery, coordinator response, trusted contact response, central station response, public safety response, dispatch, rescue, prevention of harm, or any specific outcome
Schools, churches, daycare organizations, youth organizations, camps, clubs, employers, associations, or other organizations that may invite or support minors;
Any adult who creates, manages, pays for, supervises, or authorizes a minor’s use of My Guardian Link.
Children under 13 may not create My Guardian Link accounts directly.
A parent or legal guardian must create, manage, supervise, and consent to any child profile, child account, family-managed account, or minor profile for a child under 13.
A child under 13 may use My Guardian Link only through a parent-authorized or guardian-authorized account structure approved by My Guardian Link.
Users ages 13 through 17 may use My Guardian Link only with consent and supervision from a parent or legal guardian, unless otherwise permitted by applicable law and approved by My Guardian Link.
A parent or legal guardian is responsible for explaining proper use, emergency limitations, trusted contact notifications, location sharing, and misuse consequences to the minor.
Users 18 or older may create and manage their own accounts, subject to the My Guardian Link Terms of Use and other applicable policies.
A parent or legal guardian who creates, manages, pays for, supervises, or authorizes a child or minor account is responsible for:
Providing accurate child or minor information;
Providing accurate phone number, email, and contact information;
Managing trusted contacts and emergency contacts;
Obtaining permission from trusted contacts and emergency contacts;
Explaining that My Guardian Link is not 911;
Explaining that 911 should be called directly when safe and able;
Explaining that false, prank, malicious, or improper activations are prohibited;
Monitoring and supervising the child’s or minor’s use;
Updating or deleting information when no longer accurate;
Requesting access, correction, deletion, or other privacy actions where applicable;
Not using My Guardian Link to unlawfully track, control, monitor, surveil, punish, threaten, or coerce a minor or any other person.

Where required by law, My Guardian Link may require verifiable consent from a parent or legal guardian before allowing a child under 13 to use the Services or before collecting, using, or disclosing personal information from a child under 13.
Consent methods may include one or more of the following:
Parent or guardian payment method verification;
Government ID verification through an approved verification provider, where appropriate;
Video or live confirmation, where appropriate;
My Guardian Link may reject, suspend, or terminate a child or minor account if required consent cannot be verified.

My Guardian Link may request additional information if it has reason to believe that a child account, minor account, parent account, guardian account, or consent record is inaccurate, unauthorized, fraudulent, or incomplete.
6. What Information May Be Collected for Child or Minor Accounts
Depending on the features used, My Guardian Link may collect information relating to a child or minor, including:
Child or minor phone number, if applicable;
Child or minor email address, if applicable;
Date of birth or age range;
Optional medical, allergy, disability, cognitive, caregiver, household, or safety-related information;

My Guardian Link collects only information reasonably necessary to provide, operate, protect, support, and improve the Services; maintain incident records; comply with law; prevent misuse; and protect safety.
7. Sensitive Information Involving Children and Minors
Some child or minor information may be sensitive, including:
Information showing a child’s location during an urgent event.

A parent or legal guardian should not provide optional sensitive information unless the parent or guardian understands that the information may be used and disclosed as reasonably necessary to provide the Services, including trusted contact notification, response coordination, central station escalation, public safety escalation, caregiver notification, customer support, legal compliance, misuse investigation, safety, insurance, and incident records.
8. How Child or Minor Information May Be Used
My Guardian Link may use child or minor information to:
Support parent, guardian, or caregiver notifications;
Support possible PSAP, 911, public safety, roadside, caregiver, or other escalation;
Provide See Something Say Something features;
Prevent fraud, misuse, or false activations;
Cooperate with public safety or law enforcement where permitted or required;
Support insurance, legal defense, audits, compliance, and dispute resolution.
9. How Child or Minor Information May Be Shared
When reasonably necessary to provide the Services or where permitted by law, My Guardian Link may share child or minor information with:
Family members authorized by the account;
Sponsor group administrators, where applicable and limited to authorized administrative information;
Referral group administrators, where applicable and limited to authorized administrative information;
Schools, churches, daycare organizations, camps, clubs, employers, associations, or organizations, where applicable and authorized;
SMS, phone, email, push notification, cloud, mapping, payment, security, support, and technology vendors;
Courts, regulators, insurers, legal counsel, or law enforcement where required or permitted by law.
My Guardian Link does not sell child or minor personal information as a standard business practice.

My Guardian Link does not use child or minor urgent signal information, precise location tied to an incident, optional medical information, or emergency profile information for unrelated advertising purposes.
10. Location Sharing for Children and Minors
Location sharing may be central to certain My Guardian Link features.

By enabling location features for a child or minor, the parent or legal guardian authorizes My Guardian Link to collect, use, transmit, disclose, and retain location information, including precise location, as reasonably necessary to provide the Services.

Location information may be shared with trusted contacts, emergency contacts, parents, guardians, caregivers, Urgent Response Coordinators, contact centers, central stations, public safety resources, service providers, and other authorized recipients.
Location accuracy is not guaranteed. Location may be unavailable, delayed, incomplete, or inaccurate due to:
Disabling location permissions may impair or prevent important Services from functioning.
11. Trusted Contacts, Emergency Contacts, Parents, and Caregivers
A parent or legal guardian is responsible for selecting and managing trusted contacts, emergency contacts, caregivers, parents, guardians, and other notification recipients.
By adding a person as a contact, the parent or legal guardian represents that:
The person has agreed to receive communications from or through My Guardian Link;
The parent or guardian has permission to provide the person’s contact information;
The person may receive information about the child or minor;
The person may receive location, map link, alert type, message, timestamp, incident details, or related information;
The contact information is accurate and current.
My Guardian Link is not responsible if a trusted contact, emergency contact, caregiver, parent, guardian, or other recipient fails to receive, read, answer, respond to, or act upon any communication.
12. SMS, Calls, Push Notifications, and Emails Involving Minors

My Guardian Link may send or cause to be sent SMS messages, phone calls, push notifications, emails, in-app messages, trusted contact alerts, urgent signal communications, account notices, billing notices, onboarding notices, and service communications involving a child or minor account.
By creating, managing, or authorizing a child or minor account, the parent or legal guardian consents to these communications.
Message and data rates may apply. Message frequency varies. Carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages.
Opting out of SMS, calls, push notifications, emails, or other communications may limit or disable important My Guardian Link features.
13. Sponsor Groups, Schools, Churches, Daycare, Camps, and Organizations

If a school, church, daycare organization, youth organization, camp, club, employer, association, sponsor group, referral group, enterprise customer, or other organization invites, pays for, supports, or manages access involving minors, that organization is responsible for:
Having legal authority to invite or include minors;
Obtaining required parent or guardian consent;
Complying with school, employment, caregiver, youth organization, and communications laws;
Not using My Guardian Link to unlawfully monitor, track, discipline, control, or surveil minors;
Complying with the Master Services Agreement, Data Processing Addendum, and applicable addenda.
My Guardian Link may require written confirmation from the organization that required parental or guardian consent has been obtained before activating minor-related accounts.
My Guardian Link may be used by babysitters, caregivers, parents, guardians, and family members to support urgent communication involving children.
A babysitter, caregiver, or other temporary responsible adult may use My Guardian Link only as authorized by the parent, legal guardian, account owner, or applicable law.
A babysitter or caregiver may not create a child profile, add children, submit child information, share child location, or add emergency contacts unless authorized by a parent or legal guardian.

When a babysitter or caregiver activates an urgent signal involving children, My Guardian Link may process and disclose information related to the event, including the caregiver’s identity, message, location, child-related context, trusted contacts, parent contacts, and incident details.
15. Optional Medical, Allergy, Disability, Cognitive, or Emergency Information
Parents or legal guardians may choose to provide optional emergency profile information for a child or minor.
A parent or legal guardian should provide only information that is accurate and appropriate for urgent communication support.
My Guardian Link is not a medical provider and does not provide medical diagnosis, treatment, monitoring, medical advice, or emergency medical services.

If optional medical or emergency information is provided, it may be shared with trusted contacts, caregivers, response coordinators, contact centers, central stations, public safety resources, roadside providers, service providers, or other authorized recipients as reasonably necessary to provide the Services.

The FTC Health Breach Notification Rule may apply to certain health apps and similar technologies that maintain individually identifiable health information and are not covered by HIPAA. My Guardian Link should have counsel review whether any optional medical or emergency profile feature triggers additional health-data obligations.
Subject to applicable law and verification, a parent or legal guardian may have the right to:
Review personal information collected from a child;
Withdraw consent for future collection or use;
Cancel a child or minor account;
Request a copy of certain information;
Some requests may be limited by legal, safety, billing, security, fraud prevention, public safety, incident record, insurance, dispute resolution, or legal defense needs.

For example, My Guardian Link may retain urgent signal records, location records tied to incidents, call notes, escalation records, billing records, security records, misuse records, or legal records where required or permitted by law.
17. How to Submit a Parent or Guardian Request
Website Form: [Insert Privacy Request Link, if available]
Mailing Address: 2680 Vernon Drive, Green Bay, WI 54304
Proof of parental or legal guardian authority, if requested;
Any relevant account or transaction information.
My Guardian Link may require verification before processing a request.
If My Guardian Link cannot verify the requester’s identity or authority, it may deny or limit the request.
A parent or legal guardian may withdraw consent for future collection, use, or disclosure of a child’s personal information, subject to applicable law and service limitations.
Continued retention of certain records as permitted or required by law.

Withdrawing consent does not automatically delete historical incident records, billing records, legal records, security records, misuse records, or records required for public safety, insurance, compliance, legal defense, or dispute resolution.
19. Data Retention for Children and Minors

My Guardian Link retains child and minor information only as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes described in the Privacy Policy, this Policy, and applicable agreements, unless a longer period is required or permitted by law.
When information is no longer needed, My Guardian Link may delete, de-identify, anonymize, or aggregate it.
20. No Behavioral Advertising to Children Based on Sensitive Emergency Data

My Guardian Link does not use child or minor urgent signal information, precise location tied to an incident, optional medical information, emergency profile information, or incident records for unrelated behavioral advertising.
My Guardian Link does not sell children’s personal information as a standard business practice.

If any analytics, cookies, SDKs, pixels, advertising tools, or app technologies could be considered a sale, sharing, targeted advertising, or behavioral advertising under applicable law, My Guardian Link will provide required notices, choices, consents, or restrictions.
21. Prohibited Use Involving Children and Minors
You may not use My Guardian Link to:
Create a child account without legal authority;
Create a minor account without required consent;
Pretend to be a parent or legal guardian;
Add a child who is not under your legal authority;
Use My Guardian Link to harass, threaten, punish, intimidate, stalk, track, control, or coerce a child, minor, parent, guardian, caregiver, or other person;
Use My Guardian Link for unlawful surveillance;
Use My Guardian Link in violation of custody orders, protective orders, restraining orders, school rules, employment rules, or applicable law;
Trigger false, prank, malicious, or improper activations;
Use minor information for marketing, profiling, resale, unrelated analytics, or unauthorized purposes;
Misrepresent My Guardian Link as guaranteed emergency service or replacement for 911.

Violation may result in suspension, termination, disclosure of records, referral to law enforcement, civil liability, administrative penalties, criminal consequences, reimbursement claims, and other remedies.
22. Custody, Family Disputes, and Protective Orders
My Guardian Link is not responsible for resolving custody disputes, guardianship disputes, family disputes, school disputes, caregiver disputes, or disputes between parents or guardians.
A person who creates, manages, or authorizes a child or minor account represents that they have legal authority to do so.
If My Guardian Link receives notice of a custody dispute, guardianship dispute, protective order, restraining order, no-contact order, or similar legal restriction, My Guardian Link may:
Refuse to release information until authority is verified;
Comply with court orders or legal process;
Take other action permitted by law.
My Guardian Link may rely on account records, consent records, court orders, legal documents, or verified instructions when determining access or account status.
23. Account Security for Child and Minor Accounts
Parents and legal guardians are responsible for maintaining the security of:
If a device, account, phone number, or trusted contact list is compromised, urgent alerts, location information, messages, or account information may be accessed by unauthorized persons.
Notify My Guardian Link promptly if you believe a child or minor account has been compromised.
My Guardian Link may suspend, restrict, or terminate a child or minor account if it believes:
A parent or guardian lacks authority;
The account is being used for stalking, harassment, coercion, or unlawful monitoring;
The account creates safety, privacy, legal, security, public safety, or operational risk;
The account violates the Terms of Use, Acceptable Use Policy, Privacy Policy, or this Policy;
Suspension or termination is required by law, court order, regulator, public safety request, or legal obligation.
If a child or minor uses My Guardian Link outside the United States, additional laws may apply.
Parents, guardians, and organizations are responsible for ensuring that the use of My Guardian Link complies with the laws of the applicable jurisdiction.
My Guardian Link may require additional consent, notices, restrictions, or documentation for users in Canada, Mexico, the European Union, the United Kingdom, or other jurisdictions.
Personal information may be processed in the United States and other countries where My Guardian Link or its service providers operate.
My Guardian Link may update this Policy from time to time.
The updated Policy will be posted on the website, app, account portal, onboarding screen, or another reasonable location. The “Effective Date” will show when this Policy was last updated.
Where required by law, My Guardian Link may provide additional notice or request updated consent.
Continued use of a child or minor account after an updated Policy becomes effective means the parent or legal guardian accepts the updated Policy.
For questions about this Policy or child/minor accounts, contact:
By creating, managing, paying for, supervising, or authorizing a child or minor account, I acknowledge and agree that:
1. I am the parent or legal guardian of the child or minor, or I have legal authority to provide consent.
2. I consent to the child’s or minor’s use of My Guardian Link.

3. I consent to My Guardian Link collecting, using, transmitting, disclosing, retaining, and processing the child’s or minor’s personal information as described in the Privacy Policy and this Child / Guardian Consent Policy.
4. I consent to the collection and use of location information, including precise location, when location features or urgent signal features are enabled.

5. I understand that urgent alerts may share the child’s or minor’s information with trusted contacts, emergency contacts, caregivers, Urgent Response Coordinators, contact centers, central stations, public safety resources, service providers, and other authorized recipients.

6. I understand that optional medical, allergy, disability, cognitive, caregiver, or emergency profile information may be shared as reasonably necessary to support urgent communication and response coordination.
7. I understand that My Guardian Link is not 911 and does not replace calling 911 or local emergency services.

8. I understand that My Guardian Link does not guarantee alert delivery, coordinator response, trusted contact response, central station response, public safety response, dispatch, rescue, prevention of harm, or any specific outcome.
9. I am responsible for maintaining accurate account information, trusted contacts, emergency contacts, device settings, location permissions, notification permissions, and payment information.
10. I am responsible for supervising the child’s or minor’s use of My Guardian Link.
11. I will not use My Guardian Link to unlawfully track, monitor, control, harass, stalk, threaten, or coerce any child, minor, parent, guardian, caregiver, or other person.

12. I understand that false, prank, malicious, or improper activations are prohibited and may result in suspension, termination, disclosure of records, law enforcement referral, civil liability, administrative penalties, criminal consequences, and reimbursement claims.
13. I understand that I may contact My Guardian Link to request access, correction, deletion, withdrawal of consent, or other privacy actions, subject to verification and applicable law.
14. I have read and agree to this Child / Guardian Consent Policy.
